body.x: R-PUR unveiled the anti-pollution mask specifically designed for motorbikes and bicycles users at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

This mask allows you to breathe a clean air by filtering toxic particles, fine particles, diesel, pollens as well as viruses and bacteria present in the air. This mask filtering solution offers the world’s best protection capability which is greater than the highest European norm of FFP3 breathing mask.

R-PUR uses a highly breathable fabric used in special forces uniforms for waterproofing and equips with a hot air ventilation valve to redirect heated air flow to remove the appearance of fog on glasses. Furthermore, its temperature control technology allows you to stay cool in summer or during physical activities but also protects you from the harsh winter air. You will always be comfortable all year round.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
